search_audit.query: Open 青 — historical form and meaning
search_audit.outcome: The initial construction is uncertain. Early forms combine plant-growth shapes with 丹, also written 井 in bronze forms. 丹 and 井 interchange as similar shapes. 生 and 井 share an ancient rhyme group with 青 and can act as phonetics. Plant color is a proposed semantic connection. Browser text extraction failed on a subsequent open; full page was fetched directly with requests and the 形義通解 section read successfully.
